subject: Re: Vanguard evaluation timeline & milestone-driven ramp/discount request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguard.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@vanguard.ai>, procurement@vanguard.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vanguard evaluation timeline & milestone-driven ramp/discount request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the deterministic routing features. We're ready to structure an evaluation (MAP) but have two commercial asks before we formalize the plan:

1) We need a predictable onramp for the pilot that scales to 100k tokens/day by month three. Can you confirm a proposed ramp schedule and whether that affects unit pricing?
2) Procurement requests milestone-contingent pricing: a discount velocity tied to hitting MAP checkpoints (POC completion, security review signoff, and production pilot go/no-go). We can commit to a staged purchase if the discounts kick in after each checkpoint.

I've attached a one-page checklist of the MAP steps we want to lock. Can you send a pricing scenario that maps to those checkpoints (example: 5% after POC success, additional 7% after SOC2 evidence, etc.)?

We'd like to close the evaluation plan and get a SOW out by next Friday (2026-07-24).

Cheers,
Liam
Head of ML Platforms
Vanguard.ai

Attachments: Vanguard_MAP_checklist.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguard.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vanguard evaluation timeline & milestone-driven ramp/discount request

Hi Liam — great to hear the demo resonated. Appreciated the checklist — helps a lot. See initial take below. I included Marissa (commercial lead) and Karthik (pricing/solutions) to help map commitments to discounts and availability.

High-level proposal (fast draft):
- Pilot ramp: week 0–2 (integration, up to 10k tokens/day), month 1 target 30k/day, month 2 target 70k/day, month 3 target 100k/day. We can reserve burst headroom during the pilot for testing spikes.
- Milestone-triggered discounts: baseline price shown in attached Pricing_v2.xlsx. Proposal: 4% credit after POC acceptance (MAP checkpoint 1), 6% credit after security evidence delivery (checkpoint 2, e.g., SOC2 report + audit logs), 10% credit applied on volume beyond month 3 if pilot converts to a production commit (checkpoint 3). Credits will be applied as retroactive billing credits or invoice adjustments per SOW.
- Commit mechanics: If Vanguard signs a production commit within 30 days of checkpoint 3, we can add an additional 3% scaling rebate tied to a 12-month minimum.

Next steps: Marissa — can you confirm if Finance is comfortable with the credit application path (credit vs invoice adjustment) and whether we need a separate clause for unused credits? Karthik — can you validate that the ramp targets match the capacity plan and confirm any cost delta for reserved burst capacity?

We can get an SOW draft to you by Thursday (2026-07-23) if we align on these bullet points today.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Pricing_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 22 KB), Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf, 65 KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vanguard evaluation timeline & milestone-driven ramp/discount request

Tessa / Karthik — quick internal. I reviewed the draft pricing and have two comments: 1) clarify the credit mechanics — prefer invoice-level credits that expire 90 days after issuance (to keep accounting clean); 2) for the production commit rebate, require a minimum passive usage floor (50k tokens/day avg across months 4–6) to trigger the additional 3% — otherwise we'll leave the door open for minimal conversion and high credit impact.

Karthik — capacity note: reserved burst for the pilot is fine but add a soft cap clause: bursts >150% of forecasted peak require separate approval (we should include a tiered overage rate). Also verify the backend can honor KV cache warm starts for the first week to avoid cold-start token inflation.

If we accept Marissa's two points, I'm comfortable moving to a SOW and the DocuSign path. Tessa, happy to hop on a 20-min call with the customer if they push back on the 90-day expiry.

—Marissa
VP Commercial | Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguard.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@vanguard.ai>, procurement@vanguard.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vanguard evaluation timeline & milestone-driven ramp/discount request

Tessa — thanks and appreciated the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side after internal procurement review:

- 90-day expiry on credits is acceptable, but procurement asks for clarity that credits apply only to Redwood-hosted production usage (pilot credits not transferable to third-party infra).
- For the production commit rebate trigger, Vanguard will accept the 50k tokens/day average, but we ask that the measurement window be months 4–6 following conversion (not months 4–6 following pilot start). We want a settle period.
- We have a hard procurement milestone: legal needs a clause that we can delay the production commit by up to 60 days if SOC2 evidence delivery slips — that must not void prior checkpoint discounts.

Procurement also attached an example SOW template with their preferred invoicing cadence and a clause for audit access to audit logs during the pilot. Can you incorporate those into the SOW? We are on a tight timeline — a finalized SOW + DocuSign envelope to procurement by Friday (2026-07-24) would keep us on track.

Regards,
Liam

Attachments: Vanguard_SOW_template.docx (docx, 19 KB)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@vanguard.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@vanguard.ai>, procurement@vanguard.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Vanguard MAP checkpoint language + approval to issue SOW & envelope

Team — aligning everyone and locking the commercial path. Summary of agreed commercial bullets (per thread and procurement clarifications):

- Ramp schedule: integration week 0–2 (10k/day), month 1 = 30k/day, month 2 = 70k/day, month 3 = 100k/day. Reserved burst capacity allowed up to 150% of forecast with tiered overage rates.
- Milestone-conditioned credits: 4% after POC acceptance, 6% after security evidence (SOC2 + audit logs), 10% on volume beyond month 3 if Vanguard signs a production commit. Credits applied as invoice-level credits, expire 90 days after issuance, valid only for Redwood-hosted usage.
- Production commit rebate: additional 3% for a 12-month minimum if average usage >= 50k tokens/day during months 4–6 following conversion.
- SOC2 delivery slippage: Vanguard may delay conversion up to 60 days without voiding prior checkpoint credits, provided they remain in active pilot status.
- Audit access & invoicing cadence: incorporate procurement SOW template clauses for audit log access and net-30 invoicing.

Marissa — confirm final approval to proceed with SOW language and DocuSign envelope. Karthik — please attach a short capacity note (1-page) for the SOW that details the reserved burst behaviour and KV cache warm start assurances. Liam — once we have Marissa/Karthik's confirmation, we'll push the SOW + DocuSign link to procurement before Friday EOD.

Thanks — moving this to finalize.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.docx (docx, 28 KB)
